declarations.name: AuiForm
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Form: `<form auiForm (submitted)="save($event.values)">`.
Complements Angular forms: AbsoluteUI controls also report validity to Angular
through their Validator, so `formGroup.valid` and the AbsoluteUI state agree.
Bind `(submitted)` rather than `(ngSubmit)`: ngSubmit fires before AbsoluteUI validation.

inputs.name: rules
inputs.description: Cross-field rules { fields, validate(values), target? }. Run on validate/submit and live on every edit after the first submit. The first failing rule per target wins.

inputs.name: summaryTitle
inputs.description: Error summary heading. Default: localized "There is a problem". Applied when the summary is created, on update(), and on global configuration changes.

inputs.name: summaryHost
inputs.description: Element that hosts the error summary. Read only when the summary is first created (on the first failed submission); changing it afterwards has no effect. Default: a <div> inserted as the form's first child on the first failed submit (removed on destroy).

inputs.name: focusOnInvalid
inputs.description: Where focus moves after a failed submission. Without a summary, focus always goes to the first invalid field.

inputs.name: errorSummary
inputs.description: Render an error summary on failed submission. When false, messages that belong to no field are announced assertively.

inputs.name: submitMode
inputs.description: 'event': emit aui-submit only. 'native': then call HTMLFormElement.submit() unless aui-submit was prevented (the submitter's name/value is included).

inputs.name: asyncTimeoutMs
inputs.description: Async validator timeout in ms (integer 100..120000). On timeout the signal aborts with a TimeoutError.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of the summary heading and form-level messages.

outputs.name: submitted
outputs.description: Valid submission: values and the abort signal of the submit.

outputs.name: invalidSubmit
outputs.description: Submission blocked by errors (the summary and focus are already handled).

outputs.name: stateChange
outputs.description: dirty, touched, submitting, submitCount, or valid changed (deduplicated).

outputs.name: formReset
outputs.description: The form was reset (reset() or a native reset).

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Current values of the registered controls.

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Run synchronous validation now and show the messages; true when valid.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Run the submit pipeline (validation, then `submitted` or `invalidSubmit`).

methods.name: setErrors
methods.description: Show server or cross-field errors by field name.

methods.name: clearErrors
methods.description: Remove server or custom errors set with `setErrors`.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Reset the form and every control to its initial values and clear messages.

accessibility.pattern: Native <form> with the GOV.UK error summary pattern: validate on submit, then move focus to a summary of links to each invalid field.

limitations: Double submission is blocked only while the async validator runs; after aui-submit the consumer must guard its own save request.
Plain native elements are serialized and reset but not validated; wrap them in Form Field to validate them.
Cross-field rule targets must be named controls; validate() and submit throw FORM_RULE_TARGET for an unknown target, while live re-checks after the first submit skip it.
File inputs are not serialized by getValues().
